source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: After that, a 15 min active or sham rTUS intervention was delivered to left M1.

flags.reason: Total enrolled was 40 (20 sham, 20 active); the sham-rTUS group had ultrasound intensity set to zero, so n_subjects here reflects only the 20 participants who received active rTUS.

The Discussion/safety section restates extracranial intensity as ISPPA=8.053 W/cm2 and ISPTA=0.403 W/cm2 (MI=0.696), slightly different from the Methods values (8.086/0.404, MI=0.698) used here; likely rounding or a typo.
Sham was implemented by setting ultrasound intensity to zero with the same setup in place; classified as inactive_transducer (powered off) though not explicitly described as such.

readout_other: Chinese Brief Cognitive Test (C-BCT): trail making test part A (TMT-A), symbol coding, continuous performance test (CPT), digit span
direction_notes: Active rTUS to left M1 increased ipsilateral MEP amplitude (facilitation, lasting up to 30 min) while decreasing contralateral MEP amplitude (inhibition, lasting 15 min), increasing interhemispheric laterality; sham rTUS produced no significant MEP changes.
safety_notes: No participants reported any adverse effects during or after the rTUS intervention; simulation showed a maximum temperature increase of 6.4x10^-3 degC in the skull and 6.1x10^-4 degC in the brain.

timing.protocol_description: The rTUS parameters: duty cycle (DC) 5%, tone-burst-duration 500 microseconds, sonication duration (SD) 500 ms, number of tone-bursts per train 50, PRF 100 Hz, inter-stimulus interval (ISI) 8 s, total stimulation duration 15 min (total on-state duration of rTUS was 2.657 s). For the sham-rTUS group, the ultrasound intensity was set to zero.
